notes: “Rotate it 90 degrees counterclockwise” now turns the way you asked; before, putting the number first made it turn clockwise. “Fade in and out 3 seconds” fades for 3 seconds instead of 1, and you can set a volume as a level, like “set the volume to 80%” or “turn it down to 30%”. “Double the frame rate” smooths the motion without also enlarging the video to 4K, and “triple the frame rate” or “make it 90fps” now gets 3× smoothing. Asking to fade only the music now explains that Crisp fades the picture and sound together, instead of saying it didn’t understand.
